evidence: Re-architects CScriptWitness storage and transaction deserialization bounds in consensus and validation critical paths (src/script/script.h, src/primitives/transaction.h, src/script/interpreter.cpp).
rationale: Eliminates an adversarial memory exhaustion vector in block processing where valid 4 MB blocks packed with empty or 1-byte witness elements consumed over 100 MiB of heap memory. Author benchmarks demonstrate block deserialization time falling from 279.2 ms to 18.7 ms and peak allocation dropping from 182.2 MiB to 7.8 MiB, prompting maintainers to schedule it for v33 as a critical fix.
